children: UK oil and gas producer's H1 revenue rose yr/yr, driven by higher oil prices
Operating cash flow before working capital movements increased to £6.0 mln
Company completed £9.1 mln fundraising and agreed sale of Croatian geothermal business
Company expects full-year 2026 production of 1,900-1,950 boe/d
Star Energy says it is actively evaluating acquisitions but will maintain strict investment discipline
Company's UK geothermal project progress depends on securing government support and third-party capital
HIGHER OIL PRICES - Revenue increase was primarily driven by higher Brent oil prices, though gains were partially offset by hedging losses and weaker USD:GBP exchange rate
PRODUCTION ISSUES - Production volumes declined due to operational and reliability issues and delay in grid connection for Singleton project
COST SAVINGS - Operating and administrative cost reductions offset inflationary increases, supporting cash flow
